nodes.label: create_model
nodes.desc: Single public entry point: turns a model name string plus kwargs into a built nn.Module.

nodes.label: register_model
nodes.desc: Decorator that records model entrypoints and their default pretrained configs in the global registry.

nodes.label: generate_default_cfgs
nodes.desc: Bulk-registers default pretrained cfg tables so every variant shares one source of truth.

nodes.label: build_model_with_cfg
nodes.desc: Shared construction path: resolves the pretrained cfg, instantiates the class, loads and filters weights.

nodes.label: load_pretrained
nodes.desc: Fetches checkpoint weights from the HF Hub or a URL and applies them with a remap filter.

nodes.label: VisionTransformer
nodes.desc: Reference ViT class: patch embed, transformer blocks, class token, global pool, classifier head.

nodes.label: vit_base_patch16_224
nodes.desc: Registered entrypoint factory for the classic ViT-Base/16 at 224px.

nodes.label: ResNet
nodes.desc: Parametrized ResNet class covering stem, stages, optional downsampling and head variants.

nodes.label: resnet50
nodes.desc: Registered entrypoint factory for the 50-layer Bottleneck variant.

nodes.label: PatchEmbed
nodes.desc: Conv-based image to patch-token projection shared by ViT and many hybrid models.

nodes.label: create_transform
nodes.desc: Builds train/eval torchvision transform stacks from a dataset config, incl. RandAugment and ImageNet stats.
